items.heading: This Is the Distinction Most
items.text: This is the distinction most guides skip. Classical machine learning engineering is about building and training a model from data to solve a prediction problem. Generative AI application work almost always starts from a model someone else has already trained, and the job is making that model useful, safe, and grounded inside a real product or workflow.
